2608.04678.title: Kathleen Writes: Autoregressive Generation and Data Scaling Without Attention
2608.04678.paper_summary: Papers 1-2 of the Kathleen series showed that a byte-level, attention-free architecture built from a wavetable encoder and multi-scale reverberant state can match strong baselines on classification at ~450-700K parameters, without pretraining. We ask whether the same ingredients can generate. (1) Scaling: on byte-level language modeling (WikiText-103, raw UTF-8, no tokenizer), the reverberant model beats a parameter-matched transformer at every dataset scale measured (2-512 MB), e.g. 1.84 vs 2.04 bits/byte at 512 MB with ~0.5M parameters; the transformer needs more than 512 MB to match what the attention-free model learns from 32 MB. (2) Measurement: we introduce FORM DISTANCE, a non-parametric, gaming-resistant instrument for "reads like text": nine statistical axes of human text define a reference cloud, and five constructed fakes are all rejected. (3) Generation: decoding policy dominates architecture -- widening the sampler halves the same model's distance (3.17 to 1.52), and a retrieval-augmented decoding scheme takes the frozen model further (1.52 to 1.14) with no training step involved; the ablation attributes the gain to the sparse phrase dose itself, not the selection gate. The gain has a sharp boundary condition: the phrases must come from the model's own training corpus -- a 40x larger foreign library helps not at all, an effect the attention twin shares, consistent with in-context integration being a capability of scale. We also report four architectural additions that did not help, and a computed lexicon reaching 94% of a learned table's top-1 accuracy at one fifth of the parameters. Everything runs offline; all experiments are reproducible on a free Kaggle T4.
2608.04678.paper_summary_zh: 論文1-2的Kathleen系列顯示，基於波形表編碼器和多尺度混響狀態構建的位元組級、無注意力架構可以在約450-700K參數的情況下，與分類的強基線相匹配，而無需預訓練。我們想知道相同的成分是否可以生成。(1) 擴展：在位元組級語言建模（WikiText-103，原始UTF-8，無分詞器）中，混響模型在每個測量的數據集規模（2-512 MB）上都超越了參數匹配的Transformer，例如在512 MB下，約0.5M參數時為1.84對2.04位/位元組；Transformer需要超過512 MB才能匹配無注意力模型從32 MB學到的東西。(2) 測量：我們引入FORM DISTANCE，一種非參數的抗遊戲工具，用於“讀起來像文本”：九個人類文本的統計軸定義了一個參考雲，而五個構建的假文本都被拒絕。(3) 生成：解碼策略主導架構——擴大取樣器使同一模型的距離減半（3.17到1.52），而檢索增強的解碼方案使凍結模型進一步減少（1.52到1.14），且不涉及任何訓練步驟；消融實驗將增益歸因於稀疏短語劑量本身，而不是選擇閘。增益有一個明確的邊界條件：短語必須來自模型自己的訓練語料庫——一個大40倍的外國庫完全沒有幫助，這一效應與注意力雙胞胎共享，與上下文整合作為規模的能力一致。我們還報告了四個未能提供幫助的架構添加，以及一個計算的詞彙表在參數的五分之一下達到學習表的頂部1準確率的94%。一切都在離線運行；所有實驗都可以在免費的Kaggle T4上重現。
2608.04678.author: George Fountzoulas et.al.
